sentence: The configurational evidence makes the combination itself the unit of analysis: for food firms, performance follows recipes that join marketing capabilities, customer co-creation, market orientation and an AI marketing strategy
passage: [Wu & Monfort (2023), p. 484] "The research results of FsQCA find that causal conditions of marketing capabilities, customer value co-creation, market orientation, and AI marketing strategy are necessary and sufficient recipes for higher firm performance."

gemini.note: The passage confirms that the specified combination of conditions forms a recipe for higher performance, but does not mention that these results apply specifically to food firms.
